title: Living in Harmony
seo_title: Living in Harmony Class 3 EVS Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 6)
standard_code: Class 3, Our Wondrous World Chapter 6: Living in Harmony
standard_text: Living in harmony with nature; caring for plants and animals; how animals help us and nature; communities that protect nature such as the Bishnois and the Chipko movement (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 6).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 3 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 6: kind and harmful actions, how animals help nature, caring for birds and street animals, the Chipko movement and the Bishnois. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: We share the Earth with plants and animals.
key_sub: Be kind to nature; it takes care of us.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living in harmony means living kindly with plants, animals and people. Bees pollinate flowers, owls and snakes eat rats in the fields, earthworms make soil rich and vultures clean up dead animals.

We can help by planting trees, giving water to birds, being gentle with animals and not littering. The Bishnoi community of Rajasthan protects trees and blackbucks, and in the Chipko movement villagers hugged trees to save them.

Example

How do owls help farmers?

they hunt at night

Answer: they eat rats

Example

Throwing plastic in a river is…

it harms fish

Answer: harmful

Common mistakes

  • Thinking snakes and owls are only harmful.
  • Chasing birds for fun.
  • Thinking one person cannot help nature.
